mapper.sql: permission.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND permission.app_code IN ('TENANT_ADMIN', 'TENANT_PORTAL', 'SERVICE') AND permission.resource_type IN ('DIRECTORY', 'MENU', 'BUTTON') AND permission.is_deleted = false AND (permission.feature_code IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_tenant_feature feature WHERE feature.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND feature.feature_code = permission.feature_code AND feature.enabled = true AND feature.is_deleted = false )) AND (#{rootOwner} = true OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_account_role account_role JOIN public.iam_role role ON role.tenant_id = account_role.tenant_id AND role.organization_id = account_role.organization_id AND role.id = account_role.role_id AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.tenant_id = role.tenant_id AND role_permission.organization_id = role.organization_id AND role_permission.role_id = role.id AND role_permission.permission_id = permission.id AND role_permission.is_deleted = false WHERE account_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account_role.account_id = #{accountId} AND account_role.is_deleted = false ))

UPDATE public.iam_role_data_scope_org scope_org SET is_deleted = true, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = scope_org.version + 1 FROM public.iam_role_data_policy policy WHERE policy.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND policy.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND policy.role_id = #{roleId} AND policy.is_deleted = false AND scope_org.tenant_id = policy.tenant_id AND scope_org.policy_id = policy.id AND scope_org.is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_role_data_policy SET is_deleted = true, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND role_id = #{roleId} AND is_deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT policy.id AS policy_id, policy.module_code, CASE WHEN policy.module_code = '*' THEN '默认策略' ELSE data_module.name END AS module_name, policy.scope_type, scope_org.organization_id FROM public.iam_role_data_policy policy LEFT JOIN public.iam_data_module data_module ON data_module.module_code = policy.module_code AND data_module.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.iam_role_data_scope_org scope_org ON scope_org.tenant_id = policy.tenant_id AND scope_org.policy_id = policy.id AND scope_org.is_deleted = false WHERE policy.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND policy.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND policy.role_id = #{roleId} AND policy.is_deleted = false ORDER BY CASE WHEN policy.module_code = '*' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, policy.module_code, scope_org.organization_id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_account account SET authz_version = authz_version + 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND account.is_deleted = false AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_account_role account_role WHERE account_role.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND account_role.organization_id = account.organization_id AND account_role.account_id = account.id AND account_role.role_id = #{roleId} AND account_role.is_deleted = false )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_outbox_event ( event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, tenant_id, event_type, payload_json, status, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT 'ra-' || md5(#{eventIdSeed} || ':' || account.id::text), 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', account.id::varchar, #{tenantId}, 'ROLE_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED', jsonb_build_object( 'tenantId', CAST(#{tenantId} AS varchar), 'roleId', CAST(#{roleId} AS varchar), 'accountId', account.id::varchar ), 'PENDING', #{operatorId}, #{operatorId} FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND account.is_deleted = false AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_account_role account_role WHERE account_role.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND account_role.organization_id = account.organization_id AND account_role.account_id = account.id AND account_role.role_id = #{roleId} AND account_role.is_deleted = false )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT permission.permission_code FROM public.iam_account_role account_role JOIN public.iam_role role ON role.tenant_id = account_role.tenant_id AND role.organization_id = account_role.organization_id AND role.id = account_role.role_id AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.tenant_id = role.tenant_id AND role_permission.organization_id = role.organization_id AND role_permission.role_id = role.id AND role_permission.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_permission_resource permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id AND permission.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND permission.is_deleted = false WHERE account_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account_role.account_id = #{accountId} AND account_role.is_deleted = false AND (permission.feature_code IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_tenant_feature feature WHERE feature.tenant_id = account_role.tenant_id AND feature.feature_code = permission.feature_code AND feature.enabled = true AND feature.is_deleted = false )) ORDER BY permission.permission_code
